name: Liam Goes To Snurch
source:
Liam Farrow, a genius high schooler and known animal hater, has insulted one too many crows. His wicked, unrighteous behavior has finally caught up with him, and he finds himself on the receiving end of nightly avian harassment. 

He can't live on like this. It's time for him to change his sinful ways! It's time... for him to go to church.

[From [url=https://pyonkotchi.itch.io/snurch]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
利亚姆·法罗是一位天才高中生，也是著名的动物仇恨者，他侮辱了太多乌鸦。他的邪恶、不义的行为终于让他自食恶果，他发现自己每晚都受到鸟类的骚扰。

他不能这样生活下去。是时候改变他的罪恶行为了！是时候了……他该去教堂了。

[来自[url=https://pyonkotchi.itch.io/snurch]itch.io[/url]]
